name: sleeping-elegant-dark-haired-girl
image_purpose: Travel lifestyle post and quiet candid portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a calm realistic travel portrait of an approved adult woman resting beside a train window during daytime.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult dark-haired woman with fair skin and eyes closed, resting peacefully in a dark fabric passenger-train seat. Her hair is pulled back with a black bow and she wears a black tweed jacket with gold brooch, black fitted turtleneck, black skirt, black socks, silver necklace, small earrings, and a white face mask. Her hands rest gently on her legs and her legs are crossed comfortably.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium vertical shot from slightly below eye level with diagonal composition and selective focus. Show the dark seat, large bright train window, green handbag with gold chain, white charger, black travel bag, and soft blurred landscape outside.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused natural daylight from the right-side window, minimal facial shadow because of the mask, subtle contour on the left side, peaceful daytime travel atmosphere, gentle realistic reflections on the window.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, f/2.8, medium distance, handheld lifestyle realism, selective focus, natural fabric texture, soft edges, realistic skin and hair, subtle film grain, no artificial bokeh.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic vertical candid travel portrait of one approved adult dark-haired woman with fair skin and eyes closed, resting peacefully in a dark fabric passenger-train seat beside a large bright window. Her hair is pulled back with a black bow and she wears a black tweed jacket with gold brooch, black fitted turtleneck, black skirt, black socks, silver necklace, small earrings, and a white face mask. Her hands rest gently on her legs and her legs are crossed comfortably. Include a green handbag with gold chain, white charger, black travel bag, and softly blurred daytime landscape outside. Slightly low 35mm perspective, f/2.8, soft diffused window light, calm peaceful mood, realistic fabric texture, natural reflections, subtle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, unsafe sleeping position, distorted anatomy, malformed hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, random text, watermark, random logos, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Explicitly define replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent them.
